research_methodology.intro: This quadrant was compiled independently through structured desk research, supplemented by primary research where available. It is not based on a survey or on vendor self-submission. The steps below describe how companies were identified, screened, evidenced and scored.

steps.title: Market Definition
steps.description: The market scope and the type of company that qualifies were defined first. Five parameters were then set for each axis, each with a written definition: the X axis measures core capability (products, services or technology) and the Y axis measures business capability.

steps.title: Desk and Primary Research
steps.description: Desk research covered company websites, filings, trade directories, industry publications and news. Primary research drew on B2B marketplace listings, where available, to confirm company offerings. Coverage was extended region by region until no new qualifying companies emerged.

steps.title: Screening
steps.description: Each candidate was screened against the market's inclusion criteria and required commercial role, and its market activity was verified. Distributors, resellers, consultancies, contract manufacturers and media names were excluded, and duplicate entries were consolidated.

steps.title: Evidence Compilation
steps.description: Every screened company was assessed on all ten parameters. For companies profiled on the chart, evidence was recorded parameter by parameter. Findings from B2B marketplace listings are reported as primary research; items not verified through primary research are marked as such.

steps.title: Scoring
steps.description: Each parameter is rated on a 0–100 scale against its written definition, based on the evidence available for that company. A company's X and Y scores are the simple average of its five parameter ratings on each axis, and its overall score is the average of X and Y.

steps.title: Normalization & Selection
steps.description: X and Y scores are rescaled to a 65–100 range across all companies assessed, preserving their rank order. The chart shows an equal number of companies from each of the four quadrants, with boundaries set at the median. All other companies are listed in the table below the chart.

research_methodology.scoring_note: Scoring inputs: each axis is built from five market-specific parameters, defined in the Parameter Definitions section. All parameters are equally weighted.
